title: Connectivity is monotone under edge inclusion
statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be Boolean encodings of graphs on the same finite vertex set, with every edge present in $G$ also present in $H$. If every pair of vertices in $G$ is joined by a finite path, then every pair of vertices in $H$ is joined by a finite path.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number v specifying the finite vertex set
Every edge present in G is present in H
G is connected, expressed as a reflexive-transitive reachability relation
